source: ETS 2023, ETS 2024, YBM 2025, ETS 2026 — Listening Parts 1–4

surface_form_diagnostics.interpretation: These are textual form/overlap counts, not measured visual distractor mechanisms.

composition_notes: Black-and-white documentary photographs, including portrait and landscape orientations.
Usually medium or wide enough to resolve posture, tool/object use and spatial relationships.
Some close object arrangements or interiors contain no visible people.
Foreground participants may be accompanied by background people; count all clearly visible people.
Libraries, museums, gyms and waiting rooms are retained in other rather than forced into office.

part2.indirect_definition: The requested proposition, fact, acceptance or refusal must be inferred from a contextual fact, changed premise, constraint, referral, counter-question or action rather than supplied explicitly. Borderline classifications are analyst judgements; the rate is not an official test statistic.

part3.speaker_count_basis: Distinct transcript speaker labels, with documented OCR normalization; inconsistent identity labels are unknown. Actual accents and voice identities were not verified from audio.

arcs.pattern: planning discussion → competing requirements → task assignment

part3.answer_position_notes: Semantic supporting spans have not been exhaustively annotated; lexical matching alone cannot establish where the correct answer is supported.

telephone_recorded_message: Identify speaker/service and reason for contact
Explain an issue, status update or constraint
Give remedy, callback instruction or next action
announcement: Address a defined audience and identify occasion/location
State change, benefit, problem or operational information
advertisement: Explain eligibility, discount or call to action
broadcast_news_report: Report upcoming development, advice or schedule
meeting_excerpt: Establish agenda item or operational update
Explain result, issue or supporting evidence
Assign work, ask for input or give a next step
tour: Highlight a feature or provide background
Give route, access, timing or visitor instructions
introduction_speech: Transition to program or call for participation
workshop_training: Give practice, required action or further resources
podcast: Transition to next segment, resource or promotion
instructions: Specify completion check or required follow-up

part4.answer_position_notes: Semantic supporting spans have not been exhaustively annotated; use the lexical anchor diagnostic only as a conservative text check.
part4.implied_meaning_function_basis: Classified from the abstract pragmatic function stated in the keyed option; items without an answer key remain unknown.

notable_trends: The fixed 6/25/39/30 question structure is preserved across all local exports.
Each test includes three Part 3 graphic questions and two Part 4 graphic questions.
A visual/textual hybrid taxonomy is required: maps and plans, tables, product drawings, schedules, transactions, interfaces and instructions all occur.
Question stems can be classified even when a source script or answer key is missing, but those items cannot contribute to keyed or audio-script measurements.

scope.source_material: Local exported JSON and local test-book image files. Book/year labels are directory labels; publisher authenticity and export fidelity were not independently verified.

methodology.counts: Question numbering establishes the fixed structure. All repeated conversation/talk scripts were counted once per three-question group. Graphic questions require an explicit look-at-the-graphic instruction, not incidental use of the word graphic.
methodology.percentages: Percent distributions use classified/valid items. Every distribution exposes total, classified and unknown. Each source contributes ten tests; metric-specific missing data are excluded from that metric only.
methodology.photo_classification: Visual inspection of local Part 1 photographs; one primary setting and all clearly visible people. Unreadable images remain unknown. Camera distance and salient-object frequencies were not exhaustively coded.
methodology.text_classification: Part 2 indirectness, Part 3 primary topics and Part 4 primary talk formats were analyst-coded. Question types, answer grammar/focus, indirect strategies and implied functions were extracted by ordered text rules and reviewed for source-format anomalies. These semantic categories are approximate analyst labels, not publisher annotations.
methodology.part2_type_notes: A tag overrides a suggestion/negative construction; an explicit alternative overrides generic yes-no; conventional invitation/request/suggestion forms override surface auxiliary/why forms. Embedded information questions beginning with an auxiliary remain yes_no unless covered by an earlier pragmatic category.
methodology.words: English alphanumeric word tokens; apostrophe contractions and internally hyphenated words count as one token. Speaker labels, option letters and SCRIPT/Q headers are removed. Part 2 question fields containing an exact trailing concatenation of their own options have that suffix removed. All three Part 2 responses contribute to response length.
methodology.speaker_label_normalization: Two ETS 2024 conversations contain an inconsistent Canadian speaker abbreviation within the same three-party interaction; Gn/Ch variants are normalized to Cn for counting. Two ETS 2023 conversations change gender/accent labels despite apparent identity continuity; their speaker count is unknown rather than interpreted as an additional person.
methodology.topic_notes: One primary topic per conversation, chosen from the communicative situation. A topic can contain several industries; no claim of an exclusive real-world industry classification is made.
methodology.nulls: null means not determinable or not exhaustively semantically coded in this analysis; zero means evaluated with no observation. Frequencies for semantic distractor, relationship, arc and paraphrase mechanisms are null; listed patterns are qualitative.
methodology.lexical_anchor_diagnostic: A correct option must have a unique contiguous phrase containing at least two non-stopword tokens in the transcript. Its offset is assigned to a script word-count third. Multiple candidate thirds or no unique phrase yield unknown. This diagnostic is not a semantic answer-position distribution and must not be used as an empirical quota.
methodology.graphics: Each inspected image has one primary category. Hybrid features remain in its layout description. Shares use readable/classified images. Each graphic entry retains source test and question identifiers but never source text or source-specific values.
methodology.aggregation: Counts are summed across books. Word/turn summary statistics are recomputed from item-level values, not averaged across book summaries. Recent means observed in ETS 2024, YBM 2025 or ETS 2026.
methodology.rounding: Largest-remainder apportionment of classified pooled counts; deterministic alphabetical tie break. Each independent target dimension sums to its part size. Targets are design recommendations, not reconstructed source tests.

generation_targets.basis: Pooled classified reference distributions with largest-remainder rounding. Missing/uncertain source features are not promoted into observations. Each category map is an independent design dimension; overlapping dimensions are not added together.

guidance: Rotate zero-rounded categories across a batch; a zero target in one test does not forbid that category.
If a featured action is unsupported by the photograph, revise the photo or item before publication.
Do not make every indirect answer a refusal; rotate referrals, counter-questions, source pointers and changed premises.
Place indirect answers across the part while retaining a gradual increase in contextual inference.
Do not copy source names, places, quantities, wording or arrangements.

recommended_question_slots.slot_1: Orient the listener: topic, purpose, location or identity; detail is also permitted.
recommended_question_slots.slot_2: Specific detail, concern, reason, inference or visual lookup.
recommended_question_slots.slot_3: Next action, request, consequence or later detail; vary the exact order.

guidance: Use mostly two speakers and approximately two three-speaker sets per test.
Distribute evidence naturally through the whole script; avoid a repeated rigid sentence-to-question template.
Graphic answers require an audio clue plus a visual lookup, not a spoken answer that makes the graphic unnecessary.

recommended_question_slots.slot_1: Audience, setting, topic or purpose; avoid uniform openings.
recommended_question_slots.slot_2: Supporting detail, reason, problem, implication or graphic lookup.
recommended_question_slots.slot_3: Listener action, next step, reminder, closing detail or consequence.

graphics.rotation_policy: The fine-category allocation is a pooled example, not a requirement to reuse the same five categories. Rotate rare observed categories across tests and prioritize distinct layouts/audio-link mechanisms. Match the Part 3/4 split exactly.

generation_targets.rotation_note: A zero after rounding means no fixed allocation in that example test, not a prohibited category. Rotate low-frequency categories across a batch. Count dimensions independently; photo category, setting and grammar describe the same six items.
content_rules: Create new source-independent scenarios, speakers, proper names, places, dates, prices, quantities, photographs and graphic data.
Use only abstract design patterns and aggregate statistics from this blueprint.
Do not derive new scripts by replacing names/numbers in source scripts.
Select new correct-answer positions independently and verify distractors against the new audio/image.

newer_trends.comparison: ETS 2023 versus pooled ETS 2024, YBM 2025 and ETS 2026; observed differences in these exports, not a causal year trend or a publisher design change.
interpretation: Indirect pragmatic replies occur throughout the available books; compare their measured rates before asserting a monotonic increase.

Recent exports include several practical forms, administrative checklists, visual instructions, weather and seasonal planning graphics. Recent-only means absent from the readable older sample, not newly introduced to TOEIC.
Podcast-style segments and technology-mediated workplace/service contexts are present in both older and recent samples.
Source completeness, OCR variation, publisher mix and analyst taxonomy affect small percentage differences; these differences are descriptive and were not significance-tested.

validation.semantic_classification_status: Analyst categories and rule-based classifications are descriptive approximations; null fields and explicit limitations remain visible.
